text:
zoe: Noticing a strange client-side retry pattern in the Java SDK during onboarding loads. Paginator + default retry -> synchronized retries and gateway 429 bursts.

zoe: Repro: run sampleapp with `maxConcurrency=10`, paginator prefetch=2, and a synthetic 50ms transient failure on /v1/generate. After a failure window, all clients retry at once.

zoe: Minimal snippet:
```java
Paginator p = new Paginator("/v1/generate", 32, /*prefetch=*/2);
ExecutorService ex = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(10);
while (p.hasNext()) {
  List<Item> page = p.next();
  ex.submit(() -> client.generate(page));
}
```

marc: Are we missing retry jitter or randomized backoff in Java? Our Ruby and JS SDKs add full jitter, but I think Java uses a fixed exponential backoff with same seeds.

anya: I dug into the java-sdk retry middleware—it's exponential but deterministic across threads because we use System.nanoTime() start truncated. Threads that see the same failure window end up with identical next-attempt times.

zoe: That explains the sync. Also noticed paginator prefetch keeps filling the work queue even after repeated 429s, so backlog + synchronized retries = spike.

marc: Quick mitigations: (1) add full jitter to java retry (randomize the backoff window), (2) make Paginator pause prefetch on consecutive 429s for that route, (3) recommend lowering prefetch in onboarding docs.

anya: I prototyped change: replace deterministic sleep with ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(0, backoffUpperMs). Basic patch reduces spike in my local runs. Patch gist: https://gist.github.com/anya/retry-jitter-proto

dev-bot: CI started for branch fix/java-retry-jitter build-7892

perf-bot: staging alert: `2026-04-10T11:12:34Z gateway 429 rate_limit tenant=acct-new spike=+90% path=/v1/generate`

zoe: Can we also add a backpressure hook in the SDK to tell caller to slow down? Maybe an onRateLimit callback where sample apps can reduce concurrency.

marc: Good idea. We could expose a callback in Paginator/Client that receives a RateLimitEvent {route, consecutiveCount, suggestedCooldownMs}. SDK can default to pause prefetch for suggestedCooldownMs. Apps can override.

anya: I'll open PRs: java-sdk#310 (retry jitter + backpressure hook) and sampleapp#213 (demo using onRateLimit to reduce concurrency).

zoe: For now in onboarding we should change the Java sampleapp defaults: prefetch=1, maxConcurrency=4 and add a note about jitter and prefetch tuning.

marc: Agreed. Also add a small unit test in java-sdk CI that runs multiple threads against a fake 429-producing server and asserts retries are spread (stddev > threshold).

dev-bot: PRs queued: github.com/redwood/java-sdk/pull/310, github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/213.

zoe: Thanks all 496 I'll validate with a staging ramp after merge.

anya: thumbs up.
